g.text: I like getting to bundle up by a warm fire. It's so peaceful and cozy.
The snow is just so pretty when it's fresh. And it's fun to play in.
I like to pick at peeling sunburns.
Bright warm sun, time on the beach... ocean waves.
Water blaster fights! Dog days are always a laugh.
Watching things die makes me happy.
We had these dormizone trees whose leaves used to change colors in the fall. It was so beautiful.
When Amir made us those "apple cider donuts" I think I got *hooked.*
This is going to sound weird, but I think bees are adorable. I like watching them do their thing.
Spring flowers. They're so beautiful, even if they don't last long.
that sounds like something out of a postcard
yeeeesssssss aaaghhh i miss going to the beeeaaach
OML u still have epicdrenchers in the future?!?! AMAZING
ooooh like in new ludston!! i got 2 visit there a few times. sooo pretty
I try not to think too hard about how he got the apples...
thats what makes them so beautiful. if we had them all year long we'd just ignore them
do u think i can still tan now that i'm a protoframe???
hehe saaame. best not 2 ask questions sometimes
cherry blossoms are only special bcuz they're only here 4 such a short time, u know?
we never had a fireplace in our house, always wanted 1
i think the trick to being happy in life is learning to see the beauty thats here all the time
but like a real one tho not like gas or electric but like wood
we should celebrate what stays, too
crackling n smoky n cozy n yes pls
especially when the results r so tasty
